children.name: Evidence
children.value: LIST INFO chunk ISFT (Software) at 0x38 names "Lavf60.16.100"

findings.message: The data holds 4 data-bursts of IEC 61937 with AC-3 frames, as S/PDIF passthrough writes them, not samples; the fmt chunk describes the carrier (16 bits, 2 channels at 48000 Hz), and the stream is read as AC-3.
